import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def generate_weights(history, universe):
    u = pd.Index(universe)
    z = pd.Series(0.0, index=u, dtype=float)
    if len(u) == 0:
        return z
    ac = history.get('adjusted_close')
    cl = history.get('close')
    vo = history.get('volume')
    el = history.get('eligible')
    if ac is None or cl is None or vo is None:
        return z
    ac = ac.reindex(columns=u)
    cl = cl.reindex(columns=u)
    vo = vo.reindex(columns=u)
    idx = ac.index
    if len(idx) < 130:
        return z
    last = idx[-1]
    per = idx.to_period('M')
    pm = per < last.to_period('M')
    if pm.any():
        asof = idx[pm][-1]
    else:
        asof = last
    ac = ac.loc[:asof]
    cl = cl.loc[:asof]
    vo = vo.loc[:asof]
    if len(ac) > 320:
        ac = ac.iloc[-320:]
        cl = cl.iloc[-320:]
        vo = vo.iloc[-320:]
    if len(ac) < 130:
        return z
    ac = ac.ffill()
    cl = cl.ffill()
    ret = ac.pct_change(fill_method=None)
    px = ac.iloc[-1]
    dv = (cl * vo).rolling(20, min_periods=5).median().iloc[-1]
    good = px.notna() & (px > 2.0) & dv.notna() & (dv > 5e5)
    if el is not None:
        e = el.reindex(columns=u)
        if len(e) > 0:
            e = e.loc[:asof]
            if len(e) > 0:
                good = good & e.iloc[-1].fillna(False).astype(bool)
    n = len(ac)
    p0 = ac.iloc[-1]
    p1 = ac.iloc[-22] if n >= 22 else ac.iloc[0]
    p6 = ac.iloc[-127] if n >= 127 else ac.iloc[0]
    if n >= 252:
        p12 = ac.iloc[-252]
    else:
        p12 = p6
    mom6 = p1 / p6 - 1.0
    mom12 = p1 / p12 - 1.0
    rev = p0 / p1 - 1.0
    vola = ret.iloc[-126:].std()
    good = good & np.isfinite(mom6) & np.isfinite(mom12) & np.isfinite(vola) & np.isfinite(rev)
    good = good & (vola > 0.0) & (vola < 0.15)
    cand = u[good.to_numpy()]
    if len(cand) < 20:
        return z
    m6 = mom6[cand].rank(pct=True)
    m12 = mom12[cand].rank(pct=True)
    rv = rev[cand].rank(pct=True)
    lv = vola[cand].rank(pct=True)
    score = 0.55 * m6 + 0.45 * m12 - 0.20 * rv - 0.25 * lv
    ns = int(min(50, max(10, len(cand) // 10)))
    ns = min(ns, len(cand) // 2)
    if ns < 1:
        return z
    order = score.sort_values(ascending=False)
    longs = order.index[:ns]
    shorts = order.index[-ns:]
    q = 0.49 / float(ns)
    if q > 0.02:
        q = 0.02
    w = z.copy()
    w.loc[longs] = q
    w.loc[shorts] = -q
    return w.fillna(0.0).astype(float)

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def generate_weights(history, universe):
    tickers = pd.Index(universe)
    zeros = pd.Series(0.0, index=tickers, dtype=float)
    if len(tickers) == 0:
        return zeros
    ac = history.get('adjusted_close', None)
    if ac is None or not isinstance(ac, pd.DataFrame) or len(ac.index) == 0:
        return zeros
    dates = ac.index
    last_date = dates[-1]
    wd = int(last_date.weekday())
    if wd == 4:
        target = last_date
    elif wd > 4:
        target = last_date - pd.Timedelta(days=wd - 4)
    else:
        target = last_date - pd.Timedelta(days=wd + 3)
    pos = int(dates.searchsorted(target, side='right')) - 1
    if pos < 0:
        return zeros
    cutoff = dates[pos]
    px_all = ac.loc[:cutoff]
    if len(px_all.index) < 27:
        return zeros
    window = px_all.tail(32)
    if len(window.index) < 27:
        return zeros
    rets = window.pct_change()
    rets = rets.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    vol = rets.tail(21).std(axis=0, ddof=1)
    vol_count = rets.tail(21).notna().sum(axis=0)
    vol = vol.where(vol_count >= 12)
    p_end = window.iloc[-1]
    p_start = window.iloc[-6]
    ret5 = p_end / p_start - 1.0
    ret5 = ret5.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    mean_ret = ret5.mean(skipna=True)
    if not np.isfinite(mean_ret):
        mean_ret = 0.0
    score = (ret5 - mean_ret) / (vol * np.sqrt(5.0))
    score = score.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    score_u = score.reindex(tickers)
    vol_u = vol.reindex(tickers)
    p_end_u = p_end.reindex(tickers)
    p_start_u = p_start.reindex(tickers)
    valid = score_u.notna() & np.isfinite(score_u) & vol_u.notna() & (vol_u > 0.0)
    valid = valid & p_end_u.notna() & p_start_u.notna() & (p_end_u > 0.0) & (p_start_u > 0.0)
    elig = history.get('eligible', None)
    if isinstance(elig, pd.DataFrame) and len(elig.index) > 0:
        try:
            e_sub = elig.loc[:cutoff]
            if len(e_sub.index) > 0:
                e_last = e_sub.iloc[-1].reindex(tickers)
                valid = valid & e_last.fillna(False).astype(bool)
        except Exception:
            pass
    close = history.get('close', None)
    volume = history.get('volume', None)
    if isinstance(close, pd.DataFrame) and isinstance(volume, pd.DataFrame):
        try:
            c_sub = close.loc[:cutoff].tail(20)
            v_sub = volume.loc[:cutoff].tail(20)
            dollar = c_sub * v_sub
            cnt = dollar.notna().sum(axis=0)
            adv = dollar.mean(axis=0)
            adv = adv.where(cnt >= 10)
            adv_u = adv.reindex(tickers)
            valid = valid & adv_u.notna() & (adv_u > 0.0)
            if valid.sum() > 0:
                adv_valid = adv_u[valid]
                if len(adv_valid) > 10:
                    q = adv_valid.quantile(0.20)
                    if np.isfinite(q):
                        valid = valid & (adv_u >= q)
        except Exception:
            pass
    if valid.sum() > 0:
        vol_valid = vol_u[valid]
        if len(vol_valid) > 10:
            qv = vol_valid.quantile(0.90)
            if np.isfinite(qv) and qv > 0.0:
                valid = valid & (vol_u <= qv)
    valid_scores = score_u[valid].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna()
    n = len(valid_scores)
    if n < 4:
        return zeros
    n_side = min(50, n // 2)
    if n_side < 1:
        return zeros
    ordered = valid_scores.sort_values(kind='mergesort')
    idx = ordered.index
    longs = idx[:n_side]
    shorts = idx[-n_side:]
    per = min(0.02, 0.5 / float(n_side))
    w = zeros.copy()
    if len(longs) > 0:
        w.loc[longs] = per
    if len(shorts) > 0:
        w.loc[shorts] = -per
    w = w.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).fillna(0.0).astype(float)
    w = w.clip(lower=-0.02, upper=0.02)
    return w

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def _safe_frame(history, key):
    obj = history.get(key, None)
    if isinstance(obj, pd.DataFrame) and not obj.empty:
        return obj
    return None


def _last_row_shift(df, n):
    if n <= 0:
        return df.iloc[-1]
    if n >= len(df):
        return pd.Series(np.nan, index=df.columns, dtype=float)
    return df.iloc[-1 - n]


def _cs_rank(s):
    return s.rank(method='average', pct=True) - 0.5


def generate_weights(history, universe):
    universe = pd.Index(universe)
    weights = pd.Series(0.0, index=universe, dtype=float)
    if len(universe) == 0:
        return weights

    close = _safe_frame(history, 'adjusted_close')
    close_raw = _safe_frame(history, 'close')
    if close is None:
        close = close_raw
    else:
        close = close.copy()
        if close_raw is not None:
            close_raw = close_raw.reindex(index=close.index, columns=close.columns)
            close = close.where(close.notna(), close_raw)
    if close is None or close.empty:
        return weights

    close = close.reindex(columns=universe)
    if close.empty:
        return weights
    close = close.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors='coerce')
    L = len(close)
    if L < 2:
        return weights

    if L >= 253:
        skip, lb12, lb6 = 21, 252, 126
    elif L >= 127:
        skip, lb12, lb6 = 21, 126, 63
    else:
        if L >= 4:
            skip = max(1, min(21, L // 5))
            lb12 = max(skip + 1, min(L - 1, L // 2))
            lb6 = max(skip + 1, min(L - 1, L // 3))
        else:
            skip, lb12, lb6 = 1, 1, 1

    last = close.iloc[-1]
    p_skip = _last_row_shift(close, skip)
    p_12 = _last_row_shift(close, lb12)
    p_6 = _last_row_shift(close, lb6)

    mom12 = (p_skip / p_12 - 1.0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    mom6 = (p_skip / p_6 - 1.0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    rev = (last / p_skip - 1.0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

    ret = close.pct_change()
    vol_window = min(126, max(20, L // 4))
    vol_last = ret.tail(vol_window).std().replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

    r12 = _cs_rank(mom12)
    r6 = _cs_rank(mom6)
    rrev = _cs_rank(rev)
    rvol = _cs_rank(vol_last)

    signal = 0.55 * r12 + 0.30 * r6 - 0.10 * rrev - 0.05 * rvol
    signal = signal.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

    eligible = pd.Series(True, index=universe, dtype=bool)
    elig_df = _safe_frame(history, 'eligible')
    if elig_df is not None:
        e = elig_df.reindex(columns=universe)
        if not e.empty:
            e_last = e.iloc[-1]
            try:
                eligible = e_last.fillna(False).astype(bool)
            except Exception:
                eligible = e_last.notna()
    eligible = eligible.reindex(universe).fillna(False).astype(bool)

    liquid = pd.Series(True, index=universe, dtype=bool)
    vol_df = _safe_frame(history, 'volume')
    if vol_df is not None:
        v = vol_df.reindex(columns=universe)
        if not v.empty:
            v_med = v.tail(min(20, len(v))).median()
            liquid = v_med.notna() & (v_med > 0)
    liquid = liquid.reindex(universe).fillna(False).astype(bool)

    valid = (
        eligible
        & liquid
        & last.notna()
        & (last > 0)
        & signal.notna()
    )
    valid = valid.fillna(False).astype(bool)

    ranked = signal[valid].sort_values(ascending=False)
    n = len(ranked)
    if n < 2:
        return weights

    n_side = min(50, n // 2)
    if n_side < 1:
        return weights

    longs = ranked.index[:n_side]
    shorts = ranked.index[-n_side:]
    w = min(0.02, 0.5 / n_side, 1.0 / (2.0 * n_side))
    weights.loc[longs] = w
    weights.loc[shorts] = -w
    return weights

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def _zscore(x, mask):
    v = np.where(mask, x, np.nan)
    m = np.isfinite(v)
    out = np.zeros(v.shape[0], dtype=float)
    if int(m.sum()) < 10:
        return out
    mu = np.nanmean(v)
    sd = np.nanstd(v)
    if (not np.isfinite(sd)) or sd <= 1e-12:
        return out
    z = (v - mu) / sd
    z = np.clip(z, -3.0, 3.0)
    z = np.where(m, z, 0.0)
    return z


def generate_weights(history, universe):
    tickers = pd.Index(list(universe))
    n = len(tickers)
    if n == 0:
        return pd.Series(dtype=float)
    empty = pd.Series(0.0, index=tickers, dtype=float)

    open_key = None
    for k in ('adjusted_open', 'adjusted_close', 'close'):
        if k in history:
            open_key = k
            break
    close_key = None
    for k in ('adjusted_close', 'close'):
        if k in history:
            close_key = k
            break
    if open_key is None or close_key is None:
        return empty

    try:
        op_full = history[open_key].reindex(columns=tickers)
        cl_full = history[close_key].reindex(columns=tickers)
    except Exception:
        return empty

    if op_full.shape[0] < 80:
        return empty
    op = op_full.iloc[-320:].astype(float)
    cl = cl_full.reindex(index=op.index).astype(float)
    op = op.where(op > 0.0)
    cl = cl.where(cl > 0.0)
    if op.shape[0] < 80:
        return empty

    try:
        vol_df = history['volume'].reindex(columns=tickers).reindex(index=op.index).astype(float)
    except Exception:
        vol_df = pd.DataFrame(np.nan, index=op.index, columns=tickers)

    if op.shape[0] >= 260:
        mom_series = op.shift(21) / op.shift(252) - 1.0
    elif op.shape[0] >= 140:
        mom_series = op.shift(21) / op.shift(126) - 1.0
    else:
        mom_series = op.shift(5) / op.shift(63) - 1.0
    mom = mom_series.iloc[-5:].mean()

    if op.shape[0] >= 140:
        mom6_series = op.shift(21) / op.shift(126) - 1.0
    else:
        mom6_series = op.shift(5) / op.shift(63) - 1.0
    mom6 = mom6_series.iloc[-5:].mean()

    ret = op / op.shift(1) - 1.0
    vol60 = ret.rolling(60, min_periods=40).std().iloc[-1]

    last_px = cl.iloc[-1]
    dv = (cl * vol_df).iloc[-60:].median()

    p_last = last_px.values.astype(float)
    volv = vol60.values.astype(float)
    momv = mom.values.astype(float)
    mom6v = mom6.values.astype(float)
    dvv = dv.values.astype(float)

    base = (np.isfinite(p_last) & (p_last > 1.0)
            & np.isfinite(volv) & (volv > 1e-6)
            & np.isfinite(momv))
    liquid = base & np.isfinite(dvv) & (dvv >= 1e6)
    mask = liquid if int(liquid.sum()) >= 40 else base

    if 'eligible' in history:
        try:
            el = history['eligible'].reindex(columns=tickers).reindex(index=op.index).iloc[-1]
            el_bool = np.nan_to_num(el.values.astype(float), nan=0.0) > 0.5
            m2 = mask & el_bool
            if int(m2.sum()) >= 20:
                mask = m2
        except Exception:
            pass

    if int(mask.sum()) < 4:
        return empty

    z_mom = _zscore(momv, mask)
    z_mom6 = _zscore(mom6v, mask)
    z_lowvol = _zscore(-volv, mask)
    score = 0.65 * z_mom + 0.15 * z_mom6 + 0.20 * z_lowvol
    score = np.where(mask, score, np.nan)

    idx = np.where(mask)[0]
    if idx.size < 2:
        return empty
    s_sel = score[idx]
    order = idx[np.argsort(-s_sel, kind='mergesort')]

    k = int(min(50, idx.size // 2))
    if k < 1:
        return empty

    w_side = float(min(0.02, 0.98 / (2.0 * k)))
    w = np.zeros(n, dtype=float)
    w[order[:k]] = w_side
    w[order[-k:]] = -w_side

    w = np.clip(w, -0.02, 0.02)
    w = np.where(np.isfinite(w), w, 0.0)
    return pd.Series(w, index=tickers, dtype=float)

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def _frame(history, names):
    for n in names:
        if n in history:
            obj = history[n]
            if isinstance(obj, pd.DataFrame):
                return obj
    return None


def generate_weights(history, universe):
    u = pd.Index(universe)
    out = pd.Series(0.0, index=u, dtype=float)
    if len(u) == 0:
        return out
    close = _frame(history, ['adjusted_close', 'close'])
    if close is None or close.empty:
        return out
    close = close.copy()
    cols = [c for c in u if c in close.columns]
    if len(cols) < 4:
        return out
    close = close[cols].astype(float).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    dates = close.index
    if len(dates) < 60:
        return out
    max_date = dates[-1]
    first = pd.Timestamp(year=max_date.year, month=max_date.month, day=1)
    prev_end = first - pd.Timedelta(days=1)
    cand = dates[dates <= prev_end]
    if len(cand) > 0:
        ref_date = cand[-1]
    else:
        ref_date = max_date
    px = close.loc[:ref_date]
    if len(px) < 60:
        px = close
        ref_date = max_date
    p = px.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    nrows = len(p)
    mom_lb = 126 if nrows > 126 else 60
    skip = 5
    mom = p.shift(skip) / p.shift(mom_lb) - 1.0
    ret5 = p / p.shift(skip) - 1.0
    rets = p / p.shift(1) - 1.0
    vol = rets.rolling(window=60, min_periods=30).std()
    ma = p.rolling(window=100, min_periods=50).mean()
    trend = p / ma - 1.0
    last_mom = mom.iloc[-1]
    last_ret5 = ret5.iloc[-1]
    last_vol = vol.iloc[-1]
    last_trend = trend.iloc[-1]
    last_price = p.iloc[-1]
    valid = pd.Series(True, index=cols, dtype=bool)
    valid = valid & last_price.notna() & (last_price > 0)
    valid = valid & last_mom.notna() & np.isfinite(last_mom)
    valid = valid & last_ret5.notna() & np.isfinite(last_ret5)
    valid = valid & last_vol.notna() & np.isfinite(last_vol) & (last_vol > 0)
    valid = valid & last_trend.notna() & np.isfinite(last_trend)
    elig = history.get('eligible', None)
    if isinstance(elig, pd.DataFrame):
        e = elig.reindex(index=close.index, columns=cols).ffill(limit=5)
        if len(e) > 0:
            ecur = e.iloc[-1].fillna(True).astype(bool)
            valid = valid & ecur.reindex(cols).fillna(True)

    sorted_scores = score.sort_values(ascending=False)
    top = list(sorted_scores.index[:n_side])
    bottom = list(sorted_scores.index[-n_side:])
    w = min(0.02, 0.499 / float(n_side))
    if (not np.isfinite(w)) or w <= 0:
        return out

    out = out.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).fillna(0.0)
    gross = float(np.abs(out.values).sum())
    if gross > 1.0:
        out = out * (0.999 / gross)
    return out

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def _zscore(s):
    s = s.astype(float)
    mu = s.mean(skipna=True)
    sd = s.std(skipna=True, ddof=0)
    if not np.isfinite(sd) or sd == 0:
        return s * 0.0
    return (s - mu) / sd


def generate_weights(history, universe):
    idx_univ = pd.Index(list(universe))
    zeros = pd.Series(0.0, index=idx_univ, dtype=float)
    if len(idx_univ) == 0:
        return zeros

    adj = history.get('adjusted_close')
    if adj is None:
        adj = history.get('close')
    if adj is None or adj.empty:
        return zeros

    cols = [c for c in idx_univ if c in adj.columns]
    if len(cols) == 0:
        return zeros

    ac_full = adj[cols]
    n_full = len(ac_full)
    if n_full < 30:
        return zeros

    # Rebalance every 5 trading days: use data up to the last row whose
    # integer position is a multiple of 5.  This holds weights for 5 days.
    rebal_pos = ((n_full - 1) // 5) * 5
    ac = ac_full.iloc[:rebal_pos + 1].tail(320)
    if len(ac) < 30:
        return zeros

    rets = ac / ac.shift(1) - 1.0
    rets = rets.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

    mkt = rets.mean(axis=1)
    idx_level = (1.0 + mkt.fillna(0.0)).cumprod()
    ma = idx_level.rolling(window=200, min_periods=150).mean()

    risk_off = True
    if len(idx_level) > 0 and np.isfinite(idx_level.iloc[-1]) and np.isfinite(ma.iloc[-1]):
        risk_off = bool(idx_level.iloc[-1] < ma.iloc[-1])

    # 60-day realized volatility
    vol_win = rets.tail(60)
    count = vol_win.count()
    vol60 = vol_win.std(ddof=0) * np.sqrt(252.0)
    vol60[count < 30] = np.nan

    # 20-day realized volatility (for risk-off quality momentum)
    vol_win20 = rets.tail(20)
    count20 = vol_win20.count()
    vol20 = vol_win20.std(ddof=0) * np.sqrt(252.0)
    vol20[count20 < 10] = np.nan

    # 120-day beta vs equal-weight market
    r120 = rets.tail(120)
    m120 = mkt.tail(120)
    R = r120.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    M = m120.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    n_cols = R.shape[1]
    beta_vals = np.full(n_cols, np.nan)
    for j in range(n_cols):
        x = R[:, j]
        mask = np.isfinite(x) & np.isfinite(M)
        if int(mask.sum()) >= 40:
            xv = x[mask]
            yv = M[mask]
            vy = float(np.var(yv, ddof=0))
            if vy > 0.0:
                beta_vals[j] = float(np.cov(xv, yv, ddof=0)[0, 1] / vy)
    beta = pd.Series(beta_vals, index=cols, dtype=float)

    # Momentum
    if len(ac) >= 121:
        mom120 = ac.iloc[-1] / ac.iloc[-121] - 1.0
    else:
        mom120 = pd.Series(np.nan, index=cols)
    if len(ac) >= 61:
        mom60 = ac.iloc[-1] / ac.iloc[-61] - 1.0
    else:
        mom60 = pd.Series(np.nan, index=cols)

    mom120 = mom120.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    mom60 = mom60.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

    beta_filled = beta.copy()
    if beta_filled.notna().any():
        beta_filled = beta_filled.fillna(beta_filled.median())
    else:
        beta_filled = beta_filled.fillna(1.0)

    z_mom120 = _zscore(mom120)
    z_mom60 = _zscore(mom60)
    z_beta = _zscore(beta_filled)
    z_vol60 = _zscore(vol60)
    z_vol20 = _zscore(vol20)

    if risk_off:
        # Quality momentum: high long-term momentum, low short-term vol
        score = 0.6 * z_mom120 + 0.4 * z_mom60 - 0.3 * z_vol20
        valid = mom120.notna() & mom60.notna() & vol20.notna()
        gross_scale = 0.5
    else:
        # High-beta / high-vol / high-momentum tilt
        score = 0.4 * z_mom120 + 0.3 * z_mom60 + 0.5 * z_beta + 0.4 * z_vol60
        valid = mom120.notna() & mom60.notna() & vol60.notna() & beta_filled.notna()
        gross_scale = 1.0

    score = score.where(valid, np.nan)
    n = int(score.notna().sum())
    if n < 2:
        return zeros

    K = min(30, n // 2)
    if K < 1:
        return zeros

    ranked = score.dropna().sort_values(ascending=False, kind='mergesort')
    longs = ranked.index[:K]
    shorts = ranked.index[-K:]

    w = min(0.02, 0.5 / float(K)) * gross_scale
    weights = zeros.copy()
    weights.loc[longs] = w
    weights.loc[shorts] = -w
    return weights

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def _rank_z(s, valid):
    s = s.astype(float).copy()
    s[~valid] = np.nan
    s = s.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    if s.notna().sum() < 2:
        return pd.Series(0.0, index=s.index)
    r = s.rank(pct=True)
    return (2.0 * r - 1.0).fillna(0.0)


def generate_weights(history, universe):
    u = pd.Index(universe)
    zeros = pd.Series(0.0, index=u)
    if len(u) == 0:
        return zeros

    ac = history.get('adjusted_close')
    if ac is None or ac.empty:
        ac = history.get('close')
    if ac is None or ac.empty:
        return zeros

    cols = [t for t in u if t in ac.columns]
    if len(cols) < 2:
        return zeros

    px = ac.loc[:, cols].astype(float)
    if not px.index.is_monotonic_increasing:
        px = px.sort_index()

    has = px.notna().any(axis=1)
    if not has.any():
        return zeros
    t = px.index[has][-1]
    px = px.loc[:t]
    if len(px) < 30:
        return zeros

    try:
        nb = t + pd.offsets.BDay(1)
        at_month_end = (nb.year != t.year) or (nb.month != t.month)
    except Exception:
        at_month_end = False

    if at_month_end:
        sig = t
    else:
        mask = (px.index.year < t.year) | ((px.index.year == t.year) & (px.index.month < t.month))
        prior = px.index[mask]
        if len(prior) == 0:
            return zeros
        sig = prior[-1]

    sub = px.loc[:sig]
    n = len(sub)
    if n < 30:
        return zeros
    p0 = sub.iloc[-1]

    def ret(offset):
        if n - 1 - offset < 0:
            return pd.Series(np.nan, index=cols)
        return sub.iloc[-1] / sub.iloc[-1 - offset] - 1.0

    ret21 = ret(21)
    ret5 = ret(5)
    rev21 = -ret21
    rev5 = -ret5

    recent = sub.tail(127)
    rets = recent.pct_change()
    if len(rets) > 1:
        r126 = rets.tail(126)
        vol = r126.std()
    else:
        r126 = pd.DataFrame(index=rets.index, columns=cols, dtype=float)
        vol = pd.Series(np.nan, index=cols)

    beta = pd.Series(1.0, index=cols)
    mkt21 = np.nan
    if len(r126) >= 20:
        m = r126.mean(axis=1)
        mv = m.var()
        if pd.notna(mv) and mv > 1e-12:
            mean_r = r126.mean(axis=0)
            cov = r126.mul(m, axis=0).mean(axis=0) - mean_r * m.mean()
            beta = cov / mv
        if len(m) >= 21:
            mkt21 = (1.0 + m.tail(21)).prod() - 1.0

    if pd.notna(mkt21):
        resid21 = ret21 - beta * mkt21
    else:
        resid21 = ret21
    rev_resid = -resid21

    dvol = pd.Series(np.nan, index=cols)
    v = history.get('volume')
    c = history.get('close')
    if v is not None and c is not None:
        vv = v.reindex(columns=cols).loc[:sig]
        cc = c.reindex(columns=cols).loc[:sig]
        if len(vv) > 0 and len(cc) > 0:
            vv = vv.tail(20)
            cc = cc.tail(20)
            dvol = (vv * cc).median(axis=0, skipna=True)

    eligible = pd.Series(True, index=cols)
    e = history.get('eligible')
    if e is not None:
        e = e.reindex(columns=cols)
        if sig in e.index:
            eligible = e.loc[sig].fillna(False).astype(bool)
        elif t in e.index:
            eligible = e.loc[t].fillna(False).astype(bool)

    valid = p0.notna() & (p0 > 0.5) & rev21.notna() & rev5.notna() & vol.notna() & (vol > 0)
    valid = valid & eligible.reindex(cols).fillna(False)

    if dvol.notna().any():
        pos = dvol[dvol > 0]
        if len(pos) > 0:
            thresh = pos.quantile(0.20)
            valid = valid & dvol.notna() & (dvol >= thresh)
        else:
            valid = valid & dvol.notna()
    valid = valid.fillna(False)

    if int(valid.sum()) < 10:
        return zeros

    z_resid = _rank_z(rev_resid, valid)
    z_rev21 = _rank_z(rev21, valid)
    z_rev5 = _rank_z(rev5, valid)
    z_vol = _rank_z(vol, valid)

    score = 0.55 * z_resid + 0.20 * z_rev21 + 0.15 * z_rev5 - 0.15 * z_vol
    score = score.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    score[~valid] = np.nan
    score = score.dropna()
    if len(score) < 10:
        return zeros

    n_side = min(50, len(score) // 2)
    if n_side < 1:
        return zeros

    ranked = score.sort_values()
    shorts = ranked.index[:n_side].tolist()
    longs = ranked.index[-n_side:].tolist()

    w_side = min(0.02, 0.5 / float(n_side))
    w = pd.Series(0.0, index=u)
    w.loc[longs] = w_side
    w.loc[shorts] = -w_side
    w = w.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).fillna(0.0).clip(-0.02, 0.02)
    return w

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def generate_weights(history, universe):
    empty = pd.Series(0.0, index=universe, dtype=float)
    if len(universe) == 0:
        return empty

    ac = history.get('adjusted_close')
    if not isinstance(ac, pd.DataFrame) or ac.empty:
        ac = history.get('close')
    if not isinstance(ac, pd.DataFrame) or ac.empty:
        return empty

    cols = [c for c in universe if c in ac.columns]
    if len(cols) < 4:
        return empty

    index = ac.index
    n = len(index)
    if n < 260:
        return empty

    last_pos = n - 1
    reb_pos = last_pos - (last_pos % 21)
    if reb_pos < 252:
        return empty

    prices = ac.loc[:, cols].iloc[:reb_pos + 1].copy().ffill()
    last = prices.iloc[-1]
    valid = last.notna() & (last > 0.5)

    vol_df = history.get('volume')
    if isinstance(vol_df, pd.DataFrame):
        v = vol_df.reindex(index=index, columns=cols).iloc[:reb_pos + 1].ffill()
        if len(v) >= 20:
            dollar_vol = (v.iloc[-20:] * prices.iloc[-20:]).median()
            valid = valid & dollar_vol.notna() & (dollar_vol > 1e6)

    eligible_df = history.get('eligible')
    if isinstance(eligible_df, pd.DataFrame):
        e = eligible_df.reindex(index=index, columns=cols).iloc[:reb_pos + 1].ffill().iloc[-1]
        valid = valid & e.fillna(False).astype(bool)

    prices = prices.loc[:, valid]
    if prices.shape[1] < 4:
        return empty

    p = prices.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

    mom12 = p.iloc[-21] / p.iloc[-252] - 1.0
    mom6 = p.iloc[-21] / p.iloc[-126] - 1.0
    rev21 = -(p.iloc[-1] / p.iloc[-21] - 1.0)

    rets = p.pct_change().iloc[-60:]
    vol60 = rets.std()

    r_mom12 = mom12.rank(method='average', pct=True)
    r_mom6 = mom6.rank(method='average', pct=True)
    r_rev = rev21.rank(method='average', pct=True)
    r_lowvol = (-vol60).rank(method='average', pct=True)

    score = (
        0.45 * r_mom12
        + 0.25 * r_mom6
        + 0.20 * r_rev
        + 0.10 * r_lowvol
    )
    score = score.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna()
    if len(score) < 4:
        return empty

    n_each = min(25, len(score) // 2)
    if n_each < 1:
        return empty

    ranked = pd.DataFrame({'score': score})
    ranked['ticker'] = ranked.index.astype(str)
    ranked = ranked.sort_values(['score', 'ticker'], ascending=[False, True])

    longs = ranked.index[:n_each].tolist()
    shorts = ranked.index[-n_each:].tolist()

    weight = min(0.02, 1.0 / (2.0 * n_each))
    if weight * 2.0 * n_each > 1.0:
        weight = (1.0 - 1e-12) / (2.0 * n_each)

    w = pd.Series(0.0, index=universe, dtype=float)
    for t in longs:
        if t in w.index:
            w.loc[t] = weight
    for t in shorts:
        if t in w.index:
            w.loc[t] = -weight

    return w

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def generate_weights(history, universe):
    u = pd.Index(universe)
    zeros = pd.Series(0.0, index=u, dtype=float)
    if len(u) == 0:
        return zeros

    ac = history.get('adjusted_close')
    if ac is None or not isinstance(ac, pd.DataFrame) or ac.empty:
        ac = history.get('close')
    if ac is None or not isinstance(ac, pd.DataFrame) or ac.empty:
        return zeros

    ac = ac.reindex(columns=u)
    dates = pd.DatetimeIndex(ac.index)
    if len(dates) < 126:
        return zeros

    cur = dates[-1]
    ym = dates.year.to_numpy() * 12 + dates.month.to_numpy()
    cur_ym = cur.year * 12 + cur.month
    mask = ym < cur_ym
    if not mask.any():
        return zeros

    sig_pos = int(np.where(mask)[0][-1])
    start = max(0, sig_pos + 1 - 300)
    sub = ac.iloc[start:sig_pos + 1]
    if sub.shape[0] < 60:
        return zeros

    prices = sub.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    with np.errstate(divide='ignore', invalid='ignore'):
        rets = prices[1:] / prices[:-1] - 1.0
    rets = np.clip(rets, -0.5, 0.5)
    rets[~np.isfinite(rets)] = np.nan
    T = rets.shape[0]
    if T < 126:
        return zeros

    mkt = np.nanmean(rets, axis=1)
    mkt = np.where(np.isfinite(mkt), mkt, 0.0)

    bwin = min(252, T)
    rb = rets[-bwin:]
    mb = mkt[-bwin:]
    mb_mean = np.nanmean(mb)
    if not np.isfinite(mb_mean):
        mb_mean = 0.0
    mb_dev = mb - mb_mean
    den = np.nanmean(mb_dev ** 2)
    if not np.isfinite(den) or den <= 0:
        beta = np.ones(prices.shape[1])
    else:
        rmean = np.nanmean(rb, axis=0)
        num = np.nanmean((rb - rmean) * mb_dev[:, None], axis=0)
        beta = num / den
        beta = np.where(np.isfinite(beta), beta, 1.0)
        beta = np.clip(beta, 0.2, 3.0)

    resid = rets - beta[None, :] * mkt[:, None]

    if T >= 252:
        rwin = resid[-252:-21]
    else:
        rwin = resid[-126:-21]
    if rwin.shape[0] < 20:
        return zeros

    score_raw = np.nansum(rwin, axis=0)
    vol = np.nanstd(rwin, axis=0, ddof=1)
    obs = np.sum(np.isfinite(rwin), axis=0)
    med_vol = np.nanmedian(vol)
    if not np.isfinite(med_vol) or med_vol <= 0:
        med_vol = 0.02
    vol = np.where(np.isfinite(vol) & (vol > 0), vol, med_vol)
    vol = np.clip(vol, 0.005, 0.20)
    score = score_raw / vol

    last = prices[-1]

    dollar = None
    vdf = history.get('volume')
    if vdf is not None and isinstance(vdf, pd.DataFrame) and not vdf.empty:
        vdf = vdf.reindex(columns=u)
        vsub = vdf.iloc[start:sig_pos + 1].tail(60)
        psub = sub.tail(vsub.shape[0])
        if vsub.shape[0] == psub.shape[0] and vsub.shape[0] > 0:
            dv = psub.to_numpy(dtype=float) * vsub.to_numpy(dtype=float)
            with np.errstate(all='ignore'):
                dollar = np.nanmedian(dv, axis=0)

    valid = np.isfinite(score) & np.isfinite(last) & (last > 5.0) & (obs >= max(20, rwin.shape[0] * 0.8))

    edf = history.get('eligible')
    if edf is not None and isinstance(edf, pd.DataFrame) and len(edf) > 0:
        e = edf.reindex(columns=u).iloc[-1].to_numpy(dtype=float)
        valid &= np.isfinite(e) & (e > 0.5)

    if dollar is not None:
        valid &= np.isfinite(dollar) & (dollar > 0)
        if valid.sum() >= 20:
            thr = np.nanpercentile(dollar[valid], 20)
            valid &= (dollar >= thr)

    n_valid = int(valid.sum())
    if n_valid < 20:
        return zeros

    idx = np.where(valid)[0]
    order = idx[np.argsort(score[idx], kind='mergesort')]
    n_side = min(50, n_valid // 2)
    if n_side < 5:
        return zeros

    longs = order[-n_side:]
    shorts = order[:n_side]
    side_gross = min(0.5, 0.02 * n_side)
    w = side_gross / n_side

    weights = np.zeros(len(u), dtype=float)
    weights[longs] = w
    weights[shorts] = -w
    weights = np.clip(weights, -0.02, 0.02)
    g = np.abs(weights).sum()
    if g > 1.0 and g > 0:
        weights *= 1.0 / g
    weights = np.nan_to_num(weights, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)
    return pd.Series(weights, index=u)

Using only the most recent completed month-end data, I compute 60-day realized volatility and an equal-weight market index. If the market index is above its 200-day moving average, the portfolio is risk-on: long the highest-volatility names and short the lowest-volatility names. If below, it is risk-off: long the lowest-volatility names and short the highest-volatility names. Equal 1% weights per name (capped at 2%), equal long/short counts, gross exposure 0.5, dollar-neutral, monthly rebalance. import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def generate_weights(history, universe):
    u = pd.Index(universe)
    zeros = pd.Series(0.0, index=u, dtype=float)
    if len(u) == 0:
        return zeros

    ac = history.get('adjusted_close')
    if ac is None or ac.empty:
        ac = history.get('close')
    if ac is None or ac.empty:
        return zeros

    ac = ac.reindex(columns=u)
    if ac.shape[0] < 60:
        return zeros

    idx = ac.index
    current_month = (idx[-1].year, idx[-1].month)
    prev_dates = [d for d in idx if (d.year, d.month) < current_month]
    if not prev_dates:
        return zeros

    reb_date = prev_dates[-1]
    try:
        pos = idx.get_loc(reb_date)
    except Exception:
        return zeros

    ac_hist = ac.iloc[:pos + 1]
    if len(ac_hist) < 60:
        return zeros

    ret = ac_hist.pct_change()
    if len(ret) < 20:
        return zeros

    vol = ret.tail(60).std(ddof=0)
    vol = vol.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    last_vol = vol.copy()

    mkt = ret.mean(axis=1, skipna=True).fillna(0.0)
    cum = (1.0 + mkt).cumprod()
    if len(cum) >= 200:
        ma = cum.tail(200).mean()
    elif len(cum) >= 100:
        ma = cum.tail(100).mean()
    else:
        return zeros
    risk_on = bool(cum.iloc[-1] > ma)

    elig_df = history.get('eligible')
    if elig_df is not None and not elig_df.empty:
        try:
            cur_elig = elig_df.reindex(columns=u).iloc[-1].fillna(False).astype(bool)
        except Exception:
            cur_elig = pd.Series(True, index=u)
    else:
        cur_elig = pd.Series(True, index=u)

    if elig_df is not None and not elig_df.empty:
        try:
            reb_elig = elig_df.reindex(columns=u).loc[reb_date].fillna(False).astype(bool)
        except Exception:
            reb_elig = pd.Series(True, index=u)
    else:
        reb_elig = pd.Series(True, index=u)

    last_ac_current = ac.iloc[-1]
    last_ac_reb = ac_hist.iloc[-1]

    valid = (
        cur_elig
        & reb_elig
        & last_vol.notna()
        & np.isfinite(last_vol)
        & (last_vol > 0)
        & last_ac_current.notna()
        & last_ac_reb.notna()
    )
    valid_names = last_vol[valid].dropna()
    if len(valid_names) < 6:
        return zeros

    n_side = min(25, len(valid_names) // 2)
    if n_side < 1:
        return zeros

    ordered = valid_names.sort_values(kind='mergesort')
    if risk_on:
        longs = ordered.index[-n_side:]
        shorts = ordered.index[:n_side]
    else:
        longs = ordered.index[:n_side]
        shorts = ordered.index[-n_side:]

    w = min(0.02, 0.25 / float(n_side))
    weights = zeros.copy()
    weights.loc[longs] = w
    weights.loc[shorts] = -w
    weights = weights.clip(-0.02, 0.02).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0.0).fillna(0.0)
    return weights
